To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the miss‐specifications or errors in factor levels have a significant impact on the performance of RPDs; (b) the miss‐specified factors are the ones with a large number of observations, especially those with the largest number of observations; (c) the formulations of Taguchi and the ones based on the mean and standard deviation of the response model perform well in the presence of errors in factor levels.

errors in factor levels can have an adverse impact on the optimal settings of control variables in RPDs and the performance of the formulations can be improved by considering errors in the factor levels.
